title: Share of people who are left-handed, by birth era

source.name: Historical prevalence of left-handedness (meta-analysis of birth-cohort studies)
source.publisher: I.C. McManus handedness research; Washington Post/Psychology Today summaries of the meta-analysis

notes: Rate by decade of birth, not year measured. Documented anchors: ~3% for those born ~1900, ~4% by 1920, ~12% for those born after 1960, best current overall estimate ~10.6%. Points between anchors are a smooth interpolation, not individually measured years.
